title: Design system batch 2 (dot 2): the eighteen templates' committed probe-v10 measurements judge clean, the probe-v10 detectors keep their real catches and drop the false ones, and lane.mjs keeps every lane on its own ports
steps: S1: Judge each dot-2 template's committed design-system-measurement.json (contracts/<slug>/j6/<version>/) with judgeMeasurement and preview-system-issues.json, as /ops judges it.
S2: Run the ACCENT-LEAK, PREVIEW-PARITY, empty-block and Joomla module size tests the line added.
S3: Run the lane port table and lane contract tests.
expect: S1: every one of the 18 templates leaves 0 rules failing; only SCREEN-1 may warn (a first screen that is all picture).

S2: real leaks, parity differences and empty blocks are still found; the approved templates and the fixed states pass; JA Impact fits its module under every system and a module that fits keeps its bytes.
S3: no port repeats within or across lanes 1..15; a release is measured through the contract a site built from it wears.
evidence: Committed v10 measurements of the batch-2 line plus the unit tests over the detectors and the slot emitter it changed
fence: Measurement judging and detector logic in tracy-web and tracy-ds-slot; does not drive a stand or a browser
